definition: [ הַרְמוֺן ] noun masculine meaning dubious; text perhaps corrupt; only Amos 4:3 וְהִשְׁלַכְתֶּנָֿה הַהַרְמ֫וֺנָה and ye shall cast them (your אחרית , posterity, AE ; Hi RV cast [yourselves], but read rather with Vrss as passive ׳ וְהָשְׁל shall be cast ) into Harmon ; if text be sound, some locality must be meant, though the nature of the allusion is lost ( AV , into the palace , treats הרמון improbable as = ארמון ). ᵑ7 ᵑ6 have mountain \ \ \ ( s ) of Armenia ( הַר מוֺנָה ), Symm Armenia , compare Lag Ges. Abh. 172 , Hoffm ZAW iii. 1882, 102, of exile ; Hi - St for ׳ ה read הֲדַדְרִמּוֺנָה to Hadadrimmon , proper name, of a location in plain of Jezreel, so Gunning; ᵐ5 εἰς τὸ ὄρος τὸ Ῥομμαν , whence Ew ingeniously ההר רמונה and ye shall cast Rimmonah (name of idol, supposed feminine of Rimmon 2Kgs 5:18 ) to the mountains. הָרַמִּים see אֲרַמִּי above
